name: Shooting Stars
desc: A twinkling drifting starfield pierced by rare seeded meteor streaks that decay behind them, radiating from a tunable point in the sky.

style.doc: nightsky=glowing additive trails + hot heads / ink=sumi splatter streaks w/ droplets / blueprint=dashed trajectory vectors + arrowheads (abstract schematic) / retro=green CRT phosphor pixels / iridescent=oil-slick hue-cycling trails

act.doc: shower=steady meteors from radiant / sparse=rare wandering singles / storm=bursts of many in waves
